title: Beowulf, Lines 1–11
subtitle: Hwæt! Wē Gār-Dena in gēardagum...
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body:
Hwæt! Wē Gār-Dena in gēardagum,
þēodcyninga, þrym gefrūnon,
hū ðā æþelingas ellen fremedon.

'Lo! We have heard of the Spear-Danes in days of yore, of the glory of the people-kings, how those nobles performed brave deeds.'

The opening verse paragraph. Gloss and grammar on every word. Continues with the lineage of Scyld Scefing.
